ns2:course.label: Ed Prac in Sp Fields in Ele Ed
ns2:course.description: (ED PR 238) Course in student teaching to meet requirements for certification in special fields at the elementary school level Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: For students in the early childhood education curriculum, CI 420 required and concurrent enrollment in CI 421; Satisfactory completion of all requirements of the Council on Teacher Education Undergraduate or Graduate Common Assessment Plan for Initial Certification (http://www.ed.uiuc.edu/cte/cap).
